english.note: Use 已故 as the all-purpose adjective for someone who is deceased, especially in formal or written contexts.
Use 已故 before a person's name or relationship term when referring respectfully to someone who has died.

examples.english: The works of the dead writer Jin Yong are still very popular today.
examples.traditional: 已故作家金庸嘅作品，至今仍然好受歡迎。

examples.english: The works of the late writer Louis Cha are still very popular.
examples.traditional: 已故作家金庸嘅作品到而家都仲係好受歡迎。
